correctness.rationale: Object fixed by explicit graph edges. Exhaustive matching enumeration confirms 751 nonempty faces and exact f-vector. Complete Hasse orientation check (2502 relations) proves acyclic matching of 367 pairs. Signed integral Morse projection returns all fourteen columns of the 2-by-14 differential; columns 1 and 4 have determinant -1, so the two 2-cells cancel and give twelve 3-spheres as an integral homotopy type. The full twelve automorphisms are enumerated exhaustively, all signed Lefschetz traces computed, and exact character inner products recover the direct-sum decomposition and one quotient invariant. Full-chain modular ranks 2,3,5 provide independent cross-checks without being substituted for the integral proof.

originality.rationale: The claim combines integral homotopy with complete dihedral action for this precise eleven-vertex graph. The closest published homotopy computations concern either Ind(Herschel), which is not Ind(L(Herschel)), or matching complexes of different graphs. Jonsson works complete graphs, outerplanar classification has incompatible graph hypothesis, and manifold classification has incompatible complex hypothesis. Targeted meaning, alias, parameter and exact-object searches found no covering statement; residual unindexed-source risk remains.

value.rationale: The Herschel graph is the smallest non-Hamiltonian polyhedral graph and a canonical sparse polyhedral example outside the outerplanar wedge theorem. Its complete integral matching-complex homotopy type is a natural invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice. A complete dihedral representation and one rational class surviving all symmetries give significant additional equivariant information invisible to the ordinary twelve-dimensional Betti rank and useful for comparing extremal polyhedral graph matching topology.
